env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A group-child send on a channel with a channel type parameter keeps
# the typed temporary: the parameter's Underlying is its constraint
# interface rather than a channel, so resolving the core type first
# preserves the element type for the shift. Without it the snapshot
# falls back to inference, defaults to int, and the send is rejected.
cd good
logos run .
stdout '^ok generic 4$'
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
stdout '^ok generic 4$'

-- good/go.mod --
module example.com/groupgenericchan

go 1.27
-- good/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

func send[C ~chan int8](ctx context.Context, ch C, n uint) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			ch <- 1 << n
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	ch := make(chan int8, 1)
	if err := send(context.Background(), ch, 2); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("err:", err)
		return
	}
	select {
	case v := <-ch:
		fmt.Println("ok generic", v)
	default:
		fmt.Println("err: empty")
	}
}
